remarks: Nestled in the coveted Old Hill section of Westport, this exceptional residence offers a rare blend of space, serenity, & timeless appeal. With over 3,200 square feet, the home unfolds beautifully-beginning with a gracious entry foyer, leading into the living room with hardwood floors and anchored by a classic fireplace. The large eat-in kitchen offers double ovens, an abundance of cabinets and marble countertops and opens to both the formal dining room and a more casual dining space with adjoining great room, all unified by gleaming wood floors and bathed in abundant natural light. Designed for both everyday ease and effortless entertaining, the main level also features a thoughtfully appointed mudroom with laundry, located just off the kitchen, offering generous storage for everyone's belongings. Every detail supports comfort and functionality without sacrificing style. Upstairs, four spacious bedrooms provide peaceful retreats. The primary suite is a true sanctuary, complete with a full bath, ample closet space, and a sun-filled porch that easily doubles as a home office, studio, or quiet escape. The finished lower level adds even more flexibility, featuring an office/guest room and a full bath-ideal for today's versatile living needs. Outdoors, the property truly shines. The fabulous backyard is a private oasis, highlighted by a gunite pool with spa and surrounded by lush landscaping-perfect for relaxation and summer gatherings.
